prompt.project_info: Create a natural elegant indoor satin portrait of an approved adult woman seated on a beige upholstered chair.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman with wavy light-brown hair, rosy cheeks, a soft smile, and natural makeup. She sits with legs crossed, raises one hand near her hair, looks directly at camera, and wears a champagne-light-gold satin slip dress with cowl neckline and spaghetti straps, plus small silver drop earrings and a delicate silver chain.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium knees-up portrait, beige upholstered chair, cream curtains and dark window behind, direct gaze, hand near hair, crossed-leg pose, and satin texture clearly visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft frontal light or ring-light-like illumination, gentle facial and satin highlights, natural skin, warm quiet indoor mood, restrained contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4K portrait, natural perspective, sharp face and dress texture, realistic satin folds and hands, medium depth, subtle grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a natural photorealistic 4K indoor portrait of an approved adult woman with wavy light-brown hair, rosy cheeks, a soft smile, and natural makeup. She sits with legs crossed on a beige upholstered chair, raises one hand near her hair, and looks directly at the camera. She wears a champagne-light-gold satin slip dress with a cowl neckline and spaghetti straps, small silver drop earrings, and a delicate silver chain. Include cream curtains and a dark window behind, medium knees-up framing, soft frontal or ring-light-like illumination, realistic skin and satin texture, gentle highlights, natural color, and subtle grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized framing, erotic pose, minor or child, age ambiguity, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted face, text, logo
